WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        account_count,
        CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;
